unit: MODIS-equivalent detections (Terra+Aqua, FIRMS MODIS C6.1, conf>=30, non-static)
method: w = P_aqua[FRP bin, daynight] * f[daynight, month-of-year] * L[1deg cell, daynight, season] * f_sat / n_active_viirs_sats; FRP bin uses frp / frp_scale[sat]; any AOI total = SUM(w_modis_eq). Uncertainty: validation.band_by_count (band on log1p of the AOI-month total, chosen by its predicted count). docs/plan.md §3

excluded_windows.label: S-NPP outage (VIIRS C2 BA guide v1.1 §6)

filters.static_mask: 0.01deg cells with >5 type!=0 VIIRS SP detections (all years) + 0.01deg cells with >=1 MODIS type!=0 detection 2018+; one mask for all rows

frp_scale_note: NOAA-21 FRP is divided by this before FRP binning (NOAA-20-equivalent). NOAA JPSS NOAA-21 AF readme (2023-06-01): 'minor (up to ~10%) positive bias' from the M13 SRF shift (NOAA operational product). Our FIRMS data shows a larger, uniform offset; cause of the size difference not verified. Geometric mean of q10..q90 ratios, day+night, SP shared days.

N20.overlap: SP days where S-NPP and NOAA-20 are both active, 2018-04-01..2026-07-31

N21.overlap: SP days where NOAA-20 and NOAA-21 are both active, 2023-03-01..2026-07-31

series.source: VIIRS-derived MODIS-equivalent (mean of active sats); NRT rows provisional
